Name: Unique Gift Dialogues Expanded - CHS
Author: Iwannaberich
Description:
PrincessFelicie制作了这个优秀的对话模组，为香草角色添加了110+的礼物反应对话。
文本量较多，尽量保持了角色的原本特色。
人工校对两次，代码运行没有问题，翻译如有错漏欢迎指出。

PrincessFelicie has made this excellent dialogue module that adds 110+ gift response dialogue for the Vanilla character.
The amount of text is large, and the original characteristics of the characters are kept as much as possible.
Manual proofreading twice, the code runs without problems, translation if there are errors and omissions welcome to point out.
